title: Illustrative application latency on different routes
method: Synthetic medians are 80,70,95 ms for one fixed endpoint and payload. Relative to 80 ms,70 is 12.5% lower and 95 is 18.75% higher. These are explanatory values, not measured Cloudflare performance or a promise across networks.
alt: Illustrative application latency on different routes. Direct baseline: 80 milliseconds; Tunnel on network A: 70 milliseconds; Tunnel on network B: 95 milliseconds. Illustrative values.
